note: control[0] & P2MR_LEAF_MASK must be P2MR_LEAF_VERSION (194 / 0xc2). VerifyP2MRCommitment must bind the control block to the 32-byte witness v2 program. Native tests fill the committed leaf/program from derivation.json, then apply one of these mutations.

cases.note: 0xc0 is TAPROOT_LEAF_TAPSCRIPT, not P2MR_LEAF_VERSION. Interpreter returns SCRIPT_ERR_P2MR_WRONG_LEAF_VERSION.
Leaf version 0xc2 with a sibling hash that does not reproduce the 32-byte program. VerifyP2MRCommitment fails (SCRIPT_ERR_WITNESS_PROGRAM_MISMATCH).
